symptom: Any authenticated user can dispatch invitations on behalf of arbitrary teams by swapping the teamId URL parameter.
root_cause: The AI conflated Authentication (verifying caller identity) with Authorization (verifying caller permissions over a specific resource). It verified req.user was non-null, but omitted the ownership/RBAC query joining the caller's ID with the team's admin role.
analogy: Hotel key card room number tampering: the key card proves you are a legitimate hotel guest (authenticated), but tampering with the card to unlock Room 417 grants unauthorized entry because the lock failed to verify ownership of that specific room.
ai_pattern_failure: LLMs statistical next-token prediction strongly associates API handlers with authentication middleware (generic pattern), but rarely with per-resource authorization checks (domain-specific logic), leaving IDOR holes in generated code.
